exchange.sent: What evidence is required to compare our Oscilloscope solution with a competitor for Automotive without making unsupported claims?

answer.answer:
### Short answer
To compare our Oscilloscope solution with a competitor for Automotive, the evidence must directly connect the Oscilloscope solution, the competitor, and the Automotive use case; separate passages that merely mention each facet are insufficient [100].
### Evidence required
| Required evidence | Why it is required | Current support / gap |
|---|---|---|
| Official product evidence for our Oscilloscope solution, including exact model, option code, order number, document version, and specifications | The only Oscilloscope-related evidence here identifies `R&S FSW-B2071` as “Oscilloscope baseband inputs,” order no. `1331.8302.02`, applicable to all FSW models [13]. | The passages support the option identity, but they do not state an Automotive use case for this Oscilloscope option [13]. |
| Technical specifications with conditions, not just product names | FSW8 specifications include frequency ranges, RF input impedance, connector, voltage limits, VSWR condition, power consumption, dimensions, and weight [14]. | These specifications are not tied to Automotive in the passages [14]. |
| Competitor official datasheet or third-party evidence for the competing Oscilloscope solution | R&S battle-card claims about competitors are sales positioning and not binding technical specifications [7]. | For Keysight, the passages say customer-facing use should be supported by Keysight official data and third-party evidence because current Keysight claims come from an R&S internal battle card [9]. |
| Direct evidence that the Oscilloscope solution is used for the Automotive application being compared | Automotive evidence in the passages covers other R&S solutions, such as CMX500 with CMX-KA098 for NG eCall testing under realistic network conditions [10]. | The passages do not connect FSW-B2071 or an Oscilloscope solution to Automotive testing [13][10]. |
| Automotive use-case definition and scope | The passages identify Automotive contexts such as NG eCall verification with Snapdragon Auto 5G Modem-RF using R&S CMX500 and CMX-KA098 [50]. | That Automotive evidence is for CMX500 / CMX-KA098, not an Oscilloscope solution [50]. |
| Test setup, configuration, software version, license dependencies, and pass/fail details | The NG eCall PR is missing CMX500 configuration, CMX-KA098 version, license dependencies, test setup, radio conditions, IMS configuration, voice codec, GNSS setup, and pass/fail details [49]. | Equivalent details would be needed before making Automotive performance claims for an Oscilloscope comparison [49]. |
| Third-party certification or report evidence if making certification claims | cetecom advanced is said to have conducted certification testing of an R&S hybrid eCall and NG eCall test solution [71]. | The passages also say the source does not provide a certificate number, report number, or formal type-approval authority role [32]. |
| Avoidance of sales-language claims unless supported by formal evidence | Claims such as “only,” “first,” “leadership,” “lower TCO,” and “fewer boxes” need formal evidence before use in technical comparison or customer documents [4]. | Such claims should not be used for an Oscilloscope Automotive comparison unless backed by formal specifications, conformance reports, or validated third-party evidence [4]. |
| If comparing against Keysight, Keysight official evidence for product capabilities and versions | The Keysight UXM material is described as R&S battle-card content and not Keysight official data [35]. | The passages say Keysight UXM descriptions lack official datasheets, option lists, versions, and formal model specifications [38]. |
### Bottom line
The current passages do not support a direct Automotive competitor comparison for an Oscilloscope solution; they only support the existence of the R&S FSW-B2071 Oscilloscope baseband input option and separate Automotive evidence for other R&S solutions [13][50].

Keysight
[[Keysight]]（圖中亦寫作 [[是德科技]]）是在既有 PCB 測試圖像來源中被列為高頻高速 [[PCB]] 測試解決方案相關公司的測試量測廠商名稱；在 [[2026_02_CMX500_Keysight_Sales_Battle_Card]] 中，Keysight 也被描述為大型美國 test & measurement vendor 與 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 wireless device testing 競品供應商。

Keysight › R&S 2026-02-26 battle card 中的 Keysight 描述
依 [[2026_02_CMX500_Keysight_Sales_Battle_Card]]（2026-02-26）：

- Keysight 被描述為 large US-based test & measurement vendor，總部位於 Santa Rosa, California, USA，員工數約 **16,800+**。
- 來源說 Keysight 在 semiconductor、aerospace / defense、cloud 與 wireless testing 具 strong market presence。
- 來源說 Keysight 在美國與 key semiconductor accounts 很強，並宣稱有 broad ecosystem partnerships：24/25 top tech companies、14/15 operators、25/25 semiconductor companies。
- 來源列出 Keysight portfolio：[[Keysight UXM]] 5G Wireless Test Platforms（[[Keysight E7515B]]、[[Keysight E7515W]]、[[Keysight E7515P]]、[[Keysight E7515E]]、[[Keysight E7515R]]）、[[ProbSim]] channel emulators、[[Nemo]] field test tools、[[RaySim]] digital twin engine、[[Atlas]] AI-powered device test、C-V2X 與 cybersecurity tools。
- 來源說 Keysight UXM portfolio fragmented across multiple hardware SKUs，每個 SKU 有不同 bandwidth、RF ports、Wi-Fi、Rel-17/18 capabilities。
- 來源說 Keysight software model 分散於 Atlas、Channel Studio、RaySim、Nemo、WLAN tools 與 UXM-specific feature options，並稱 no unified automation environment。
- 來源說 Keysight support model 使用 tiered [[KeysightCare]] model：Assured、Enhanced、Application Software Support，另有 optional warranty and calibration assurance plan。

- RFU18、FR3、2000 MHz aggregated bandwidth、AI Script Assistant、Keysight RaySim / Atlas / Channel Studio 的正式功能邊界與版本仍需補來源。

Rohde & Schwarz verifies Next Generation eCall for EN 17240_2024 Standard › 重點摘要
- [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 宣稱其與 [[Qualcomm Technologies]] 合作，驗證 [[Snapdragon Auto 5G Modem-RF]] 上 [[Next Generation eCall]]（NG eCall）的 implementation，並稱其符合 [[EN 17240]]:2024。
- 來源說 [[eCall]] 於 2015 年導入，且自 2018 年起成為歐盟境內所有新車銷售的 mandatory requirement。
- 來源指出，隨著 2G / 3G circuit-switched cellular networks 逐漸 obsolete，emergency call systems 需要適配到 4G / 5G packet-switched cellular networks。
- 來源稱 [[European Commission]] 在其 most recent regulation 中定義 NG eCall 將自 **2026-01-01** 起成為 obligatory。
- 來源稱 EN 17240:2024 建立在 IP Multimedia Subsystem（[[IMS]]）networks 上測試 eCall systems 的 guidelines，涵蓋 advanced 4G LTE 與 5G NR technologies。
- [[Snapdragon Auto 5G Modem-RF]] 被描述為 5G automotive-grade platform，支援 high-speed connectivity、advanced positioning、Vehicle-to-Everything（[[V2X]]）、multi-band [[GNSS]] navigation 與 enhanced safety。
- 來源稱驗證流程使用 [[R&S CMX500]] mobile radio tester，作為 NG eCall voice and data transmission 的 comprehensive testing solution。
- 來源稱測試模擬 [[PSAP]]，並驗證 implementation at both ends with the [[EN 17240]]:2024 standard。
- 來源說 [[R&S CMX500]] 支援 4G 與 5G technologies，目標是讓方案 future-proof。
- [[Juergen Meyer]] 以 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] Vice President Market Segment Automotive 身分在新聞稿中引述，稱此次 collaboration 為 future emergency call services 建立 new benchmark。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] 搭配 [[R&S CMX-KA098]] software option 可在 realistic network conditions 下用於 NG eCall testing。
- 來源將合作定位為 mutually validating solutions、reducing effort、accelerating time to market for mutual customers。
- Press and media contact 為 [[Patrizia Muehlbauer]]，職稱 PR Manager Products & Standard Systems。
- 公司資訊段落稱 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 2024/2025 fiscal year net revenue 為 EUR 3.16 billion，2025-06-30 worldwide employees more than 15,000。

7. RedCap testing 是否要在 main 5G signaling tester 中，或能接受 separate RedCap-only box？

### Short answer
To compare our Oscilloscope solution with a competitor for Automotive, the evidence must directly connect the Oscilloscope solution, the competitor, and the Automotive use case; separate passages that merely mention each facet are insufficient [100].
### Evidence required
| Required evidence | Why it is required | Current support / gap |
|---|---|---|
| Official product evidence for our Oscilloscope solution, including exact model, option code, order number, document version, and specifications | The only Oscilloscope-related evidence here identifies `R&S FSW-B2071` as “Oscilloscope baseband inputs,” order no. `1331.8302.02`, applicable to all FSW models [13]. | The passages support the option identity, but they do not state an Automotive use case for this Oscilloscope option [13]. |
| Technical specifications with conditions, not just product names | FSW8 specifications include frequency ranges, RF input impedance, connector, voltage limits, VSWR condition, power consumption, dimensions, and weight [14]. | These specifications are not tied to Automotive in the passages [14]. |
| Competitor official datasheet or third-party evidence for the competing Oscilloscope solution | R&S battle-card claims about competitors are sales positioning and not binding technical specifications [7]. | For Keysight, the passages say customer-facing use should be supported by Keysight official data and third-party evidence because current Keysight claims come from an R&S internal battle card [9]. |
| Direct evidence that the Oscilloscope solution is used for the Automotive application being compared | Automotive evidence in the passages covers other R&S solutions, such as CMX500 with CMX-KA098 for NG eCall testing under realistic network conditions [10]. | The passages do not connect FSW-B2071 or an Oscilloscope solution to Automotive testing [13][10]. |
| Automotive use-case definition and scope | The passages identify Automotive contexts such as NG eCall verification with Snapdragon Auto 5G Modem-RF using R&S CMX500 and CMX-KA098 [50]. | That Automotive evidence is for CMX500 / CMX-KA098, not an Oscilloscope solution [50]. |
| Test setup, configuration, software version, license dependencies, and pass/fail details | The NG eCall PR is missing CMX500 configuration, CMX-KA098 version, license dependencies, test setup, radio conditions, IMS configuration, voice codec, GNSS setup, and pass/fail details [49]. | Equivalent details would be needed before making Automotive performance claims for an Oscilloscope comparison [49]. |
| Third-party certification or report evidence if making certification claims | cetecom advanced is said to have conducted certification testing of an R&S hybrid eCall and NG eCall test solution [71]. | The passages also say the source does not provide a certificate number, report number, or formal type-approval authority role [32]. |
| Avoidance of sales-language claims unless supported by formal evidence | Claims such as “only,” “first,” “leadership,” “lower TCO,” and “fewer boxes” need formal evidence before use in technical comparison or customer documents [4]. | Such claims should not be used for an Oscilloscope Automotive comparison unless backed by formal specifications, conformance reports, or validated third-party evidence [4]. |
| If comparing against Keysight, Keysight official evidence for product capabilities and versions | The Keysight UXM material is described as R&S battle-card content and not Keysight official data [35]. | The passages say Keysight UXM descriptions lack official datasheets, option lists, versions, and formal model specifications [38]. |
### Bottom line
The current passages do not support a direct Automotive competitor comparison for an Oscilloscope solution; they only support the existence of the R&S FSW-B2071 Oscilloscope baseband input option and separate Automotive evidence for other R&S solutions [13][50].

- 來源稱 [[European Commission]] 在其 most recent regulation 中定義 NG eCall 將自 **2026-01-01** 起成為 obligatory。
- 來源稱 EN 17240:2024 建立在 IP Multimedia Subsystem（[[IMS]]）networks 上測試 eCall systems 的 guidelines，涵蓋 advanced 4G LTE 與 5G NR technologies。

- 來源說 [[R&S CMX500]] 支援 4G 與 5G technologies，目標是讓方案 future-proof。
- [[Juergen Meyer]] 以 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] Vice President Market Segment Automotive 身分在新聞稿中引述，稱此次 collaboration 為 future emergency call services 建立 new benchmark。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] 搭配 [[R&S CMX-KA098]] software option 可在 realistic network conditions 下用於 NG eCall testing。
- 來源將合作定位為 mutually validating solutions、reducing effort、accelerating time to market for mutual customers。
- Press and media contact 為 [[Patrizia Muehlbauer]]，職稱 PR Manager Products & Standard Systems。
- 公司資訊段落稱 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 2024/2025 fiscal year net revenue 為 EUR 3.16 billion，2025-06-30 worldwide employees more than 15,000。

HSD PCB image 14 › 原文未解的問題
- 來源未標示內容日期、發布日期、資料期間、作者、原始網址或報告名稱。
- `@shwaiwang2022` 中的 `2022` 是帳號字串，不是內容日期。
- 來源未定義 H-VLP2、H-VLP、VLP、RTF、通用等級的標準來源、測試方法、粗糙度數值、Dk/Df、插入損耗或可靠度條件。
- 來源未定義 FZ-WS、FV-WS、FT1-UP、F-WS、FT2-UP、DGTSEU2-MP、GTS-STD、GTS-MP 的供應商、產品系列、規格書或版次。
- 來源未定義 HVLP4，也未提供「市場已經來到HVLP4的標準」的市場範圍、時間、樣本、驗證客戶或出貨量。
- 來源未提供「加工費越貴」的價格、單位、期間、地區或比較基準。
- 來源未說明「日本三井、福田、古河、金居」的列名是否完整、是否為供應商、是否為通過認證廠商、是否為客戶或是否為作者整理名單。
- 原文 / OCR 中「金居為使數通過認真的台廠」語句不清，不能推論為「已通過認證」或任何具體認證狀態。
- 來源未說明 [[古河]] 是否等同於既有頁面 [[古河電工]]。

HSD PCB image 14 › 與既有知識的關係
- 與 [[HVLP銅箔]]：本來源補充 HVLP 的圖上定義、粗糙度 / 傳輸損失方向性、銅箔等級與箔品種對照，以及 HVLP4 市場標準說法；但來源未標示日期、測試標準或材料規格。
- 與 [[AI 伺服器 PCB 供應鏈升級]]：既有頁面已有 [[AI Server PCB test image 4]] 對 HVLP 第4、5代與 [[HSD PCB image 1]] 對 HVLP3 / HVLP4 的說法；本來源新增一張未標示日期的 HVLP 分級示意圖，不可視為獨立的市場統計或量產證明。
- 與 [[AI 伺服器 PCB 原物料台日韓供應鏈]]：既有 [[TrendForce]]（Nov., 2025）圖將 [[三井]]、[[福田]]、[[古河電工]]、[[金居]] 等列於銅箔供應鏈分類；本來源則以未標示日期圖卡列出「日本三井、福田、古河、金居」的市場說法，兩者口徑不同，不應合併成完整供應商名單。
- 與 [[三井]]、[[福田]]、[[金居]]：本來源提供未標示日期的銅箔 / HVLP 語境列名。
- 與 [[古河電工]]：本來源只寫「古河」，未寫「古河電工」；因此新增 / 使用 [[古河]] 作為未決名稱，不直接併入 [[古河電工]]。

HSD PCB image 14 › 重點摘要
- [[HSD PCB image 14]]（來源未標示日期；取得於 2026-09-04）標題為「電解銅箔HVLP」。
- [[HSD PCB image 14]]（來源未標示日期；取得於 2026-09-04）將銅箔等級列為：H-VLP2、H-VLP、VLP、RTF、通用。
- [[HSD PCB image 14]]（來源未標示日期；取得於 2026-09-04）將箔品種列為：FZ-WS、FV-WS、FT1-UP、F-WS、FT2-UP、DGTSEU2-MP、GTS-STD、GTS-MP。
- [[HSD PCB image 14]]（來源未標示日期；取得於 2026-09-04）用箭頭標示「低粗度」與「低傳輸損失」，右側截面模式圖標示「粗糙度越來越低」。
- [[HSD PCB image 14]]（來源未標示日期；取得於 2026-09-04）用途示例包括「支持5G設備、毫米波雷達」、「高頻服務器、高端路由器」、「各種FPC（智能手機等）」、「服務器、路由器」、「家電、各種電子設備」。
- [[HSD PCB image 14]]（來源未標示日期；取得於 2026-09-04）圖下方條列稱「HVLP銅箔也就是極低輪廓銅箔」，並稱其具備信號傳輸性能、低損耗特性與穩定性，是極低損耗高頻高速電路基板的核心材料；此為圖上文字說法，來源未提供測試條件或標準版本。
- [[HSD PCB image 14]]（來源未標示日期；取得於 2026-09-04）圖下方條列稱「從VLP → HVLP，隨著AI帶動規格升級，HVLP的規格越高，加工費也越貴」，並稱「市場已經來到HVLP4的標準」；來源未提供市場範圍、價格、加工費單位或 HVLP4 定義。
- [[HSD PCB image 14]]（來源未標示日期；取得於 2026-09-04）圖下方條列稱「主要大廠包含：日本三井、福田、古河提供，而金居為使數通過認真的台廠」；其中「使數通過認真」語句疑似 OCR 或原圖文字難辨，不能改寫為認證、量產或供應事實。
- 頁尾 / 水印可見 `@shwaiwang2022 @beta.finance`；`2022` 出現在帳號字串中，不是內容日期。

HVLP銅箔 › 來源中的說法
- [[AI Server PCB test image 4]]（來源未標示日期；取得於 2026-09-04）在「材料升級方向」列寫明：[[HVLP銅箔]] 進入第4、5代，[[CCL]] 以 [[M8]] 為主，導入低介電、低損耗與高散熱設計。
- [[AI Server PCB test image 4]]（來源未標示日期；取得於 2026-09-04）在「TPCA Show焦點」列寫明：TPCA Show 聚焦玻纖布、HVLP銅箔、CCL 發展與高縱深比設備。
- [[HSD PCB image 14]]（來源未標示日期；取得於 2026-09-04）標題為「電解銅箔HVLP」，並將 [[HVLP銅箔]] 放在電解銅箔等級 / 品種分級示意圖中。
- [[HSD PCB image 14]]（來源未標示日期；取得於 2026-09-04）圖下方條列稱「HVLP銅箔也就是極低輪廓銅箔」，並稱其具備信號傳輸性能、低損耗特性與穩定性，是極低損耗高頻高速電路基板的核心材料；來源未提供測試條件或標準版本。
- [[HSD PCB image 14]]（來源未標示日期；取得於 2026-09-04）用箭頭把「低粗度」與「低傳輸損失」連在一起，右側截面模式圖標示「粗糙度越來越低」。
- [[HSD PCB image 14]]（來源未標示日期；取得於 2026-09-04）圖下方條列稱「從VLP → HVLP，隨著AI帶動規格升級，HVLP的規格越高，加工費也越貴」，並稱「市場已經來到HVLP4的標準」。
- [[HSD PCB image 4]]（來源未標示日期；轉換於 2026-09-04）標題同樣為「電解銅箔HVLP」，並將 H-VLP2、H-VLP、VLP、RTF、通用列為銅箔等級。
- [[HSD PCB image 4]]（來源未標示日期；轉換於 2026-09-04）圖下方條列稱「HVLP銅箔也就是極低輪廓銅箔，表面粗糙度極低，具備出色的信號傳輸性能、低損耗特性以及極高穩定性，是極低損耗高頻高速電路基板的傳用核心材料」。其中「傳用核心材料」疑似 OCR / 讀圖不穩，未改寫為標準術語。
- [[HSD PCB image 4]]（來源未標示日期；轉換於 2026-09-04）稱「從VLP → HVLP，隨著AI帶動規格升級，HVLP的規格越高，加工費也越貴，現在市場已經來到HVLP4的標準」。來源未定義 [[HVLP4]]、市場範圍、時間或價格口徑。

HVLP銅箔 › 可追溯限制
- [[AI Server PCB test image 4]] 未定義 HVLP 的完整名稱、粗糙度規格、世代差異、供應商、量產狀態或測試條件。
- 「第4、5代」是 [[AI Server PCB test image 4]] 的圖上文字；來源未說明世代分類標準或與任何產業標準的對應。
- [[HSD PCB image 14]] 未標示內容日期、資料期間、作者、原始網址或報告名稱；頁尾 `@shwaiwang2022` 中的 `2022` 是帳號字串，不是內容日期。
- [[HSD PCB image 4]] 未標示內容日期、資料期間、作者、原始網址或報告名稱；raw frontmatter 的 converted: 2026-09-04 是轉檔日期，不是內容日期。
- [[HSD PCB image 14]] 與 [[HSD PCB image 4]] 未提供 H-VLP2、H-VLP、VLP、RTF、通用等級的數值定義、測試方法、粗糙度單位、Dk/Df、插入損耗或可靠度條件。

- 本頁不能把 HVLP銅箔第4、5代或 HVLP4 推論為已在所有 AI server PCB 導入，也不能推論特定廠商供應關係。

Edge AI Chips image 30 › 重點摘要
- 來源標題為「義隆電 (Elan) – 智慧晶片」。
- 圖表類型不是統計圖表，而是公司 / 產品介紹型簡報頁；沒有座標軸、單位、時間序列或市占資料。
- 圖上列出四個主要應用方向：
  - [[ITS]] / 智慧交通：影像辨識、號誌控制、闖紅燈預測。
  - [[Automotive]]：先進駕駛輔助系統、智慧座艙顯示、調光。
  - [[Drone]]：影像辨識、目標追蹤、360度避障。
  - [[Wearable]]：智慧穿戴、眼鏡、耳機、手錶。
- 右側條列寫有「和中研院合作推出 Yolov4 / v7 / v9」，並列出智慧交通(ITS)、汽車(Automotive)、無人機(Drone)、智慧穿戴(Wearable)。
- 右下圖片列出 solution 類別：Biometric Solutions、Pen & Touch Input Solutions、Touchpad Solutions、Pointstick Solutions、Microcontrollers。
- 圖上網址為 `https://www.emc.com.tw/emc/tw/Products`。
- 圖上沒有日期、年份或季度；內容日期為「來源未標示」。

Edge AI Chips image 30 › 使用限制
- 只能支持圖上列名、應用分類與 OCR 可辨識文字。
- 不可由此推論 [[Elan]] 的晶片型號、規格、量產、出貨、客戶、營收、市占或供應鏈關係。
- 不可由同頁出現推論 [[Elan]] 與 [[中研院]] 的正式合作範圍或商業關係。
- 不可將本來源與 [[Edge AI Chips image 2]]、[[Edge AI Chips image 28]] 視為三份獨立市場證據；它們高度重疊且存在 OCR / 讀圖差異。

Edge AI Chips image 30 › 與既有知識的關係
- [[Edge AI Chips image 30]] 與既有 [[Edge AI Chips image 2]]、[[Edge AI Chips image 28]] 都是 [[Elan]] / 義隆電智慧晶片相關圖卡，內容高度重疊，應視為同系列 / 重複讀圖補充，不可當成獨立市場驗證。
- 既有 [[Elan]] 頁面已記錄 [[Edge AI Chips image 2]] 與 [[Edge AI Chips image 28]] 的應用分類；本來源補充較清楚的「闖紅燈預測」、「360度避障」、「眼鏡、耳機、手錶」等 OCR 文字。
- 本來源強化 [[中研院]] 與 [[Elan]] 同頁同句出現的可追溯性，但仍不能推論合作合約、產品化、部署案例、量產或客戶關係。
- 本來源屬於 [[Market]] 類資料，但沒有內容日期；所有市場性主張都必須附註「來源未標示日期」。

cetecom advanced › 使用限制
- 本頁只依新聞稿記錄 cetecom advanced 在本次 R&S eCall solution certification testing 中的角色。
- 不可由此推論 cetecom advanced 對所有 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] automotive test solutions 皆有 certification 關係。
- 來源未提供 cetecom advanced 的完整法律名稱、總部地址、認證範圍、accreditation number 或測試報告。

cetecom advanced › 與 R&S eCall 測試方案的關係
[[cetecom advanced certifies Rohde & Schwarz test solution for hybrid and Next Generation eCall testing]] 說 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的 solution 通過 cetecom advanced certification testing。該 solution 以 [[R&S CMX500]] 為基礎，並使用更新後的 [[R&S CMX-KA09x]] eCall evaluation solution，以支援 [[EN 18052]]:2025 與 [[EN 17240]]:2024+A1:2026。

來源並未說明 cetecom advanced 是否出具 formal certificate、certificate number、測試報告編號或完整 type-approval authority role。

cetecom advanced
[[cetecom advanced]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 新聞稿中列名的 independent test laboratory，來源稱其為多領域產品測試與 worldwide certification 機構。

### Short answer
To compare our Oscilloscope solution with a competitor for Automotive, the evidence must directly connect the Oscilloscope solution, the competitor, and the Automotive use case; separate passages that merely mention each facet are insufficient [100].
### Evidence required
| Required evidence | Why it is required | Current support / gap |
|---|---|---|
| Official product evidence for our Oscilloscope solution, including exact model, option code, order number, document version, and specifications | The only Oscilloscope-related evidence here identifies `R&S FSW-B2071` as “Oscilloscope baseband inputs,” order no. `1331.8302.02`, applicable to all FSW models [13]. | The passages support the option identity, but they do not state an Automotive use case for this Oscilloscope option [13]. |
| Technical specifications with conditions, not just product names | FSW8 specifications include frequency ranges, RF input impedance, connector, voltage limits, VSWR condition, power consumption, dimensions, and weight [14]. | These specifications are not tied to Automotive in the passages [14]. |
| Competitor official datasheet or third-party evidence for the competing Oscilloscope solution | R&S battle-card claims about competitors are sales positioning and not binding technical specifications [7]. | For Keysight, the passages say customer-facing use should be supported by Keysight official data and third-party evidence because current Keysight claims come from an R&S internal battle card [9]. |
| Direct evidence that the Oscilloscope solution is used for the Automotive application being compared | Automotive evidence in the passages covers other R&S solutions, such as CMX500 with CMX-KA098 for NG eCall testing under realistic network conditions [10]. | The passages do not connect FSW-B2071 or an Oscilloscope solution to Automotive testing [13][10]. |
| Automotive use-case definition and scope | The passages identify Automotive contexts such as NG eCall verification with Snapdragon Auto 5G Modem-RF using R&S CMX500 and CMX-KA098 [50]. | That Automotive evidence is for CMX500 / CMX-KA098, not an Oscilloscope solution [50]. |
| Test setup, configuration, software version, license dependencies, and pass/fail details | The NG eCall PR is missing CMX500 configuration, CMX-KA098 version, license dependencies, test setup, radio conditions, IMS configuration, voice codec, GNSS setup, and pass/fail details [49]. | Equivalent details would be needed before making Automotive performance claims for an Oscilloscope comparison [49]. |
| Third-party certification or report evidence if making certification claims | cetecom advanced is said to have conducted certification testing of an R&S hybrid eCall and NG eCall test solution [71]. | The passages also say the source does not provide a certificate number, report number, or formal type-approval authority role [32]. |
| Avoidance of sales-language claims unless supported by formal evidence | Claims such as “only,” “first,” “leadership,” “lower TCO,” and “fewer boxes” need formal evidence before use in technical comparison or customer documents [4]. | Such claims should not be used for an Oscilloscope Automotive comparison unless backed by formal specifications, conformance reports, or validated third-party evidence [4]. |
| If comparing against Keysight, Keysight official evidence for product capabilities and versions | The Keysight UXM material is described as R&S battle-card content and not Keysight official data [35]. | The passages say Keysight UXM descriptions lack official datasheets, option lists, versions, and formal model specifications [38]. |
### Bottom line
The current passages do not support a direct Automotive competitor comparison for an Oscilloscope solution; they only support the existence of the R&S FSW-B2071 Oscilloscope baseband input option and separate Automotive evidence for other R&S solutions [13][50].
